onboarding.text: Theo here. I play drums in Paper Lanterns. Our singer, Cass, left her phone in the van after last night's show. She's been skipping practice for weeks, and people keep saying she's going solo.
onboarding.label: Theo

onboarding.text: We started this band in her mom's garage six years ago. Wrote our best song on my apartment floor with no heat. She sings, I keep time. That's always been the deal.
onboarding.label: Theo & Cass

onboarding.text: That's Cass Delgado. Lead vocals, lyrics, waits tables at Marlowe's so we can afford strings. Loudest laugh in any room. Lately, though, she's whispering into her phone at 2 a.m.
onboarding.label: Cass

onboarding.text: She'll be back for it soon. I'm not proud of this, but I need to know what's going on before she walks in. Help me figure out my bandmate. Please.

notes.title: Yoga - 20 min morning flow
notes.body:
YouTube routine I actually stick to

1. cat/cow x 10
2. low lunge each side, hold 5 breaths
3. pigeon (ugh) 1 min each
4. thread the needle
5. forward fold, roll up slow
6. 5 min lying on the floor doing nothing

On show days skip the twists, they mess with my breathing. Do the neck rolls instead. Studio in Silver Lake has a drop-in class on weeknights if I get my life together.

notes.title: lyrics - untitled (porch song)
notes.body:
the porch light hums like it's got something to say
I keep my keys in my fist till the bus pulls away
verse 2: you were folding laundry, I was folding in
bridge: if the street is a river then I'm a paper boat

needs a better last line. something with the word 'later'.

notes.title: Throat stuff
notes.body:
Dr. Okafor said:
- rest the voice when it's raw, no whispering either (worse)
- steam, 10 min before bed
- water water water
- skip the whiskey before sets, sorry
- if it lasts more than two weeks come back

What helps: ginger + honey + lemon, salt water gargle, those lozenges in the green wrapper. What doesn't: coffee on an empty stomach, the Fresno motel air conditioning.

notes.title: Elysian Park loop
notes.body:
The good walk: park at the Stadium Way pullout, up past the community garden, lookout bench, back down by the picnic tables. About 3 miles, 55 min if I don't stop for photos.

Bring: water, hat, earbuds (new playlist), hair tie.
Go early, it's brutal after 11.

Saw a coyote near the water fountain last time. He didn't care about me at all.

notes.title: Mamá's arroz rojo
notes.body:
From the phone call, she talks too fast

- 2 cups long grain rice, toast in oil until it smells like popcorn
- blend 2 roma tomatoes + 1/4 white onion + 1 garlic clove, strain it
- 3 cups caldo (chicken, NOT water, "mija, no water")
- cover and DON'T LIFT THE LID. 20 min
- peas and carrots at the end

Tía Rosa puts a whole jalapeño on top. Mamá says that's cheating. Try it both ways for Sunday dinner at her place.

notes.title: Ginger tea (the real one)
notes.body:
3 thick slices of ginger, simmer 10 min
big spoon of honey
squeeze of lemon
pinch of cayenne if the throat is really bad
NO dairy before a show. Learned that the hard way.
